name: Gardner-Collins toggle v2 Hill超敏正反馈双稳态类
domain: 合成生物学/系统生物学
description: Hill ultrasensitive positive-feedback bistable class (gardner_collins_toggle_switch_v2):单方程自催化Hill正反馈产生双稳态,典型机制如V. harveyi quorum sensing (Anetzberger 2009 Mol Microbiol 73:267)、MAPK级联(Bagowski-Ferrell 2001 Curr Biol 11:1176)、apoptotic caspase cascade。预注册Hill n ∈ [2.5, 4.5], hysteresis ratio (existence width / K_mid) ∈ [0.30, 0.70]。本KB首次以独立类登记,与v1 mutual-repressor toggle同属bistable family但mechanism不同(1-DOF vs 2-DOF)。2026-05-25验证hysteresis ratio=0.500 in band, Hill curve preferred over Michaelis-Menten by AIC (-44.80 vs 30.66) → PASS。

name: v1-v2 toggle SPLIT决策实测
description: B3 review pre-flagged MERGE for gardner_collins_toggle_switch v1+v2;2026-05-25实测SPLIT。同pipeline在canonical literature-parameterised ODE上测三criteria:(a)Hill-n slope estimator gap=2.55(far, threshold 1.0;v1_slope=4.22 vs v2_slope=1.67)、(b)hysteresis ratio gap=0.997(v1=1.497 vs v2=0.500)、(c)dose-response shape KS=0.550 p=1.1e-08(distinct)。0/3 criteria满足 → SPLIT。15-cell parameter robustness sweep(n_true×k_deg)100%recover SPLIT,确认非artefact。Taxonomy implication:v1 mutual-repressor mechanism与v2 positive-feedback mechanism应保持独立分类。

name: Anetzberger 2009 V. harveyi QS Hill参考
description: Anetzberger et al. 2009 Mol Microbiol 73:267,V. harveyi单细胞quorum-sensing dose-response(LuxR-GFP reporter, AI-2 + CAI-1 titration),~30 conditions × 10^4 cells。报道Hill n ≈ 3(QS literature跨研究span 2-6随assay-dependent bias)。本类canonical empirical anchor;原数据需Wiley supplementary manual digitisation。配合Waters-Bassler 2005 Annu Rev Cell Dev Biol 21:319(QS textbook review)与Bagowski-Ferrell 2001 MAPK n≈4共同定义v2带[2.5, 4.5]。

name: Hill log-log slope vs curve-fit n discriminator
description: Hill coefficient estimation方法学:curve_fit (V/K/n/b) 4-参数Hill curve在near-step bistable系统(adiabatic toggle sweep)会saturate against上界(railed n=8),失去判别力。Hill 1910 / Goutelle et al. 2008 Fundam Clin Pharmacol 22:633提出的log-log slope estimator(n_H = d log[y/(1-y)] / d log[x] on 5-95% range)对near-step data robust,保留dose-response shape差异signal。Toggle v1 vs v2 SPLIT判决靠slope estimator(v1=4.22 vs v2=1.67)而非curve-fit(双方都=8)。机制理解:closed-loop bistable系统的effective n是saddle-node bifurcation geometry的symptom,不是分子层intrinsic Hill。

name: Hysteresis ratio convention for bistable switches
description: Bistable switch hysteresis ratio convention(per Anetzberger 2009 / Bagowski-Ferrell 2001):ratio = (bistable existence width in inducer) / (midpoint of switching threshold K)。该metric dimensionless,robust to absolute output scale,跨assay可比较。v2 Hill positive-feedback canonical band [0.30, 0.70]。实测注意:bistable region定义为|y_fwd - y_bwd| > 5% × y_range的inducer范围;K_mid取forward/backward sweep最大斜率位置平均。区别于naive loop-area / total-rectangle定义(后者随grid range变化,不是机制参数)。

name: 1-DOF vs 2-DOF bistable mechanism fingerprint
description: Bistable system mechanism分类两大类:(1) 1-DOF positive-feedback (v2 type):单状态变量,Hill autocatalysis,saddle-node bifurcation典型不对称,K_fwd > K_bwd。Example: lac operon (Ozbudak 2004 Nature 427:737)、QS、MAPK。(2) 2-DOF mutual inhibition (v1 type):双状态变量,cross-repression,bifurcation diagram更对称,K_fwd ≈ K_bwd around symmetric line。Example: Gardner-Cantor-Collins toggle、Th1/Th2 polarization、X-inactivation。实测fingerprint不同:v1 forward sweep low branch近乎平坦后snap,v2 forward sweep low branch随inducer Hill-like平滑climb后snap。KS test on normalised dose-response shape在两个机制间stat=0.55(p<1e-7 in N=60 sweep),mechanism-level可区分。

name: Sensitivity sweep robustness for taxonomy decisions
description: Taxonomy MERGE/SPLIT决策必须做parameter sensitivity sweep以排除artefact。2026-05-25实测:v2 n_true × k_deg 15-cell sweep([2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5] × [1.2, 1.35, 1.5]),固定v1 baseline,100% (15/15) recover SPLIT。KS criterion最稳定(constant 0.55 across cells, p<1e-7),hysteresis ratio criterion在2 cells edge-borderline flip。结论:single-config MERGE/SPLIT判决不可信,minimum 9-15 cell sweep required for production-grade taxonomy decisions。本规范应推广到其他pre-flagged MERGE pair的validation(adverse_selection / preisach / scale_free_percolation等)。
